summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the PV audit history feature. All 10 test cases passed successfully. The feature correctly implements: 1) 'Historique des modifications' section with entry count, 2) Toggle button to expand/collapse history, 3) Audit entries with correct icons (green shield for validate, amber unlock for unlock), 4) Performer name 'Sophie Martin' displayed, 5) Timestamps in dd/MM/yy HH:mm format, 6) Decision stats badges ('3 Admis') for validate entries, 7) History sorted by most recent first, 8) New entries added on unlock/validate actions.
seed_data_creation: PV was validated and unlocked multiple times during testing, creating 5 audit log entries
context_for_next_testing_agent: PV audit history feature is fully functional. The Rh formation has 3 students (Bernard Lucas 10.50, Dubois Alice 13.00, Petit Emma 14.00) all marked 'Admis'. The pv_audit_log table stores entries with: period_id, formation_id, action (validate/unlock), performed_by, performer_name, details (jsonb with stats), created_at. The audit section has data-testid='pv-audit-section', toggle button has data-testid='toggle-history-btn', list has data-testid='pv-history-list', each entry has data-testid='audit-entry-{id}'. Previous iterations: 1-28.

tests_executed.test: 1. Login admin, go to notes-admin > Rh > Gérer les notes > Jury & Délibération tab
tests_executed.details: Successfully logged in as admin.principal@nectforma-demo.com and navigated to Jury & Délibération tab

tests_executed.test: 2. Verify 'Historique des modifications' section is visible with a count of entries (should be >=1)
tests_executed.details: Audit section found with data-testid='pv-audit-section'. Toggle button shows 'Historique des modifications (3)' - count >= 1 as expected

tests_executed.test: 3. Click the 'Historique des modifications' toggle to expand the history list
tests_executed.details: Clicked toggle button with data-testid='toggle-history-btn', history list expanded showing entries

tests_executed.test: 4. Verify each entry shows: action icon, action description, performer name, timestamp
tests_executed.details: Entry 1: 'PV et resultats valides par Sophie Martin 3 Admis 16/04/26 19:01' - green shield icon. Entry 2: 'PV et resultats deverrouilles par Sophie Martin 16/04/26 19:01' - amber unlock icon. Entry 3: 'PV et resultats valides par Sophie Martin 3 Admis 16/04/26 19:00' - green shield icon

tests_executed.test: 5. For 'validate' entries: verify decision stats badges are shown (e.g., '3 Admis')
tests_executed.details: Validate entries show '3 Admis' badge with green background (bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700)

tests_executed.test: 6. Verify the history is sorted by most recent first (newest at top)
tests_executed.details: Entries sorted by timestamp descending - newest entry (19:09) at top, oldest (19:00) at bottom

tests_executed.test: 7. Click 'Modifier le PV et resultats' (unlock) - verify a new entry appears in the history
tests_executed.details: Clicked unlock button, entries increased from 3 to 4. New entry has amber unlock icon

tests_executed.test: 8. Re-validate the PV - verify another entry is added
tests_executed.details: Clicked validate, confirmed in dialog, entries increased from 4 to 5. New entry has green shield icon

tests_executed.test: 9. Expand history - verify it now shows the new entries with correct icons and timestamps
tests_executed.details: History shows 5 entries with correct icons: validate (green), unlock (amber), validate (green), unlock (amber), validate (green)

tests_executed.test: 10. Verify the toggle button correctly collapses/expands the history
tests_executed.details: Toggle collapse: history list hidden. Toggle expand: history list visible again
